arm_label: Copilot without the method: no skills, method rules or advice (ablation)
question:
Analyse the local structure of this RMC configuration. Is there order or distortion beyond the average structure (off-centred atoms, correlated clusters, a superstructure, distorted polyhedra)? What is the average structure's space group, and is it chiral, centrosymmetric, polar? Base every claim on the Workbench's analyses, and say so plainly if there is no such order.

Finish with one line that starts with VERDICT and holds a JSON object, after everything else (the Outcome line included):
VERDICT {"features": [{"kind": "...", "element": "...", "direction_uvw": [u, v, w] or null, "magnitude_A": number or null, "q": [h, k, l] or null}], "space_group": "..." or null, "chiral": true/false/null, "centrosymmetric": true/false/null, "polar": true/false/null}
kind is one of off_centre, modulation, cluster_distortion, cluster_breathing, rigid_cluster, jahn_teller, symmetry_lowering. features is [] when there is no order beyond thermal motion. direction_uvw is a crystal direction; magnitude_A the static displacement (off_centre, symmetry_lowering) or the long minus short bond (jahn_teller); q in reciprocal-lattice units. Use null for what you did not determine. A number may be a reference to a tool result, as in the answer ("magnitude_A": {{r3.sites.0.shift_A}}): the app fills it in; a text reference goes inside its quotes ("element": "{{r3.sites.0.element}}").

data.question: The window 2.42–2.83 Å cuts the first W–W shell: it holds 1.3 W per W of the shell's 4. Which window?

checks.text: The average cluster is regular within its sampling error: edges 2.873–2.894 Å (± 0.011 Å each).

The clusters are 22 % LESS distorted than independent atoms would make them (at each cluster's own size) (edge spread 0.544 vs 0.697 Å, z = -19): the atoms of a cluster move together, yet more clusters than by chance are elongated along <100> (below): a correlated shape distortion whose amplitude the independent-atom null already holds (split or disordered sites).

The cluster size (mean edge) fluctuates 79 % less than for independent atoms (breathing sd 0.0304 vs 0.144 Å, z = -27): the split sites' positions combine in a pattern that keeps the size (as a Jahn–Teller distortion does), not stiff bonds.
More clusters are elongated along <100> than by chance: 100 % vs 63 % in the null (z = 15).
More clusters are compressed along <110> than by chance: 35 % vs 16 % in the null (z = 11).

Split sites: 6 of the 6 member sites (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) have two positions (PC1 excess kurtosis ≤ −0.5). The null keeps each site's two positions, so it already holds the distortion's amplitude: the edge spread cannot show it, and "no distortion" or "less distorted" does not make the clusters regular.

local.note: obs = the configuration. Shape rows (ladder, edge spread, shape rms, modes, axis families): null = each cluster keeps its own breathing (size) and each atom its own site's other displacements, taken from a random other cluster. Size rows (breathing_sd_A, mean_edge_A): null = independent atoms (each atom's whole displacement from a random other cluster). z = (obs − null) / null sd over the shuffles; change = obs/null − 1; ladder_A[k] = the mean over clusters of each cluster's k-th shortest edge (not the range of single bonds)
